Subject: Re: POC kickoff - avail and load window

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Acme is ready to move into a hands-on POC. Two items we want to lock down before the kickoff:

1) A 90–120 minute working session (orientation + guided prompts) the week of May 3. We have a couple of engineers joining and want a short technical deep-dive on routing/fallback behavior.

2) A dedicated 2-hour load-validation window (ramp test) where we can exercise concurrent prompt streams and measure token throughput and KV cache hit-rate. Can you propose a slot and a proposed ramp plan?

Also, can you share pre-reads (agenda, prompt packet, and the load plan) so our security team can triage data retention questions?

Thanks — looking to confirm a time by Friday.

Best,
Alyssa
Director, Data Products
Acme Analytics

Team —

Looping you in to lock dates and responsibilities. Proposed plan:

- Orientation + hands-on session (90m): Tue May 4, 10:00–11:30 PT (we'll do a 15m intro, 60m guided prompts + routing tests, 15m wrap).
- Load validation window (120m): Thu May 6, 13:00–15:00 PT — controlled ramp with three concurrency stages (5 -> 25 -> 60 streams).

Marissa: lead the guided prompts and run the prompt lexicon review.
Dev: set up a temporary routing policy that demonstrates region fallback and a quantized model variant; run the KV cache priming step during stage 2.
Naomi: own telemetry + token-cost measurement; coordinate the TTL and retention notes for Acme's security questions.

Alyssa — can you confirm the attendee list and whether you prefer an earlier/later timezone? If Tue/Thu above don't work, propose alternatives and we'll re-align.

Attachments I'm preparing: POC_Orientation_Playbook_v1.1.pdf (agenda + responsibilities), Prompt_Packet-ACME.docx (30 curated prompts and edge cases), LoadTest_RampPlan.xlsx (ramp schedule + expected token rates), RunOfShow-HandsOn.md (minute-by-minute script).

If schedule is confirmed, I'll push calendar invites and a short pre-read bundle.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC orientation playbook, load validation window and pre-reads

Thanks for the quick confirmations. Finalized notes below and pushing calendar invites now.

1) Schedule
- Orientation + hands-on: Tue May 4, 10:00–11:30 PT (Calendar invite sent).
- Load validation (ramp): Thu May 6, 13:15–15:15 PT (start shifted per Acme CI).

2) Pre-reads (attached to this thread and Drive):
- POC_Orientation_Playbook_v1.1.pdf — runbook, roles, success criteria, rollback plan.
- Prompt_Packet-ACME.docx — prioritized prompts, expected outputs, edge-case markers.
- LoadTest_RampPlan.xlsx — ramp stages, target tokens/sec, expected P99 guidance.
- RunOfShow-HandsOn.md — minute-by-minute script and slide pointers.

3) Technical details / answers to Jorge's questions
- Peak plan: 60 concurrent streams at ~6–8 tokens/sec (avg) per stream is our target. Expect sustained aggregate of ~30–45k tokens/minute.
- P99 tail: with dedicated capacity the P99 for the quantized variant is typically ~220–350ms per token for this config; fp16 baseline is ~140–200ms. We'll instrument telemetry so you can see tail lines in real time.
- Model variant: We'll run the quantized profile for stage 3 (peak) and fp16 for stages 1–2. Dev will also demo the automatic fallback to a lower-cost variant if we hit a degraded GPU node.

4) Security & retention notes (Naomi)
- Naomi: I've asked Naomi to include a one-page redaction/retention summary in the Drive link; that will address your security team's checklist items.

5) Action items (owners / due)
- Karthik: send calendar invites, invite link, and Drive bundle (done).
- Marissa: dry-run of prompt flows on Mon May 3, 11:00–12:00 PT.
- Dev: provision temporary routing policy and quantized variant by Mon EOD May 3.
- Naomi: drop retention summary and telemetry dashboard snapshot by Mon EOD May 2.

If anything changes I'll update the invites. Looking forward to the session — we'll keep the runbook flexible and have a quick escalation path if the load test needs to be paused.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
